items.Sentence: Activated sludge tanks provide suspended-growth biological treatment, with initial treatment in an anoxic zone followed by further treatment in an aerobic zone.

Flow from the activated sludge tanks goes to the membrane tanks for further treatment, including filtration by membranes and removal of sludge. Citric acid and sodium hypochlorite solutions are used for required periodic cleaning of the surfaces of membranes in the membrane tanks.
The Discharger proposes to construct a new activated sludge (AS) tertiary treatment plant...will include nitrogen removal using nitrification and denitrification (NDN) processes.
the AS/NDN treatment plant (when completed) will replace the existing secondary treatment facilities (oxidation ponds).
Removed sludge is either returned to the activated sludge tanks...
Solids generated from oxidation pond cleaning will be hauled offsite for disposal/reuse at an authorized reuse or disposal site.
